bioconda.name: agsyn
bioconda.summary: A Genome-guided method for large-scale comparative Synteny analysis.
bioconda.description:
Please cite: Fu Y, Sun W, Hansson B. Evolutionary dynamics of sex chromosomes and candidate sex-determining genes across the beetle phylogeny. bioRxiv. 2026. doi: 10.64898/2026.07.17.739015.
If you used abysw, please also cite https://github.com/abysw/abysw or abysw.com.

build.script:
mkdir -p $PREFIX/bin
mkdir -p $PREFIX/share/agsyn
cp -r abysw/bin/* $PREFIX/bin/
cp -r abysw/perl $PREFIX/share/agsyn/
cp -r abysw/R $PREFIX/share/agsyn/
cp -r abysw/shell $PREFIX/share/agsyn/
cp -r abysw/ref $PREFIX/share/agsyn/
cp -r abysw/config $PREFIX/share/agsyn/
cp README.md $PREFIX/share/agsyn/
cp agsyn.yml $PREFIX/share/agsyn/
chmod +x $PREFIX/bin/*
chmod +x $PREFIX/share/agsyn/perl/* || true
chmod +x $PREFIX/share/agsyn/R/* || true
chmod +x $PREFIX/share/agsyn/shell/* || true
